title: Jet vs Missile
one_line: Fly a stealth jet through the sky while launchers on the ground fire ever-smarter homing missiles at you.
how_to_play: Phone (sideways): drag your left thumb to fly, hold FIRE (aims itself), hold SHIELD, tap STEALTH, CAMO, FLARES, SQUAD, HEAL. Computer: WASD to fly (let go and the autopilot keeps flying), mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, E shield, V stealth, C camouflage. Game controller: sticks to fly and aim, d-pad up for stealth.
description: Six mobile launchers on the ground fire homing missiles that climb, turn and chase your jet. A missile never shoots: it hits you or blows itself up right next to you, and your jet goes down in flames, so shoot them down first, raise your shield at the last moment, or vanish with 2 seconds of stealth. The higher you fly, the smaller and harder to hit your jet becomes. Missiles grow from short range to hypersonic as the levels rise and learn tactics like dodging your shots, flanking and jamming. Every 5 levels both sides get faster and stronger. Play with touch on a phone, keyboard and mouse, or a game controller. Levels 1 to 100 plus endless overdrive, and a 2-player duel where the missile has to ram the jet.
